row: Kidz-N-Motion is a mobile all in one physical therapy app developed by Dr. LaFonda Beneby. Dr Beneby is the CEO of Therapy in Motion, PA. Therapy In Motion, PA is a dedicated provider of in-home and school-based physical therapy to children from kindergarten through 12th grade. With a team of skilled physical therapists, they create tailored treatment plans for children facing disabilities or injuries while offering guidance to rising young athletes. From assessment to rehabilitation, Therapy In Motion, PA is committed to helping children achieve their physical milestones and overall wellness, ensuring they reach their full potential.
